The time difference between these entries is from September 21, 2026 (16:00) to September 28, 2026 (10:00). This gap seems to imply that Adam may not have received the measurements from LiHua in a timely fashion, or he might have been waiting for LiHua to send the information to him directly rather than expecting LiHua to inform him. The conversation suggests a streamlined process where LiHua provides the measurements and Adam acknowledges the receipt of them, which implies effective communication between the two.
